label: Results archive (make_results_archive.py): copies of run folders for the supervisor and the paper. Read-only towards the run folders. Paths are relative to the robot_vision folder unless noted.
archive_root_note: Outside the repository (a folder next to it). Override with --archive-root or archive_root in configs/results_archive.local.json (git-ignored). Each build writes a new results_archive_<time>/ and its zip; nothing is overwritten.

frozen_extra_configs.note: not hashed: task and mode switch between runs; its fixed trial settings are checked against hri_frozen.json -> tasks.<task>.trials_fixed

exclude.note: Model weights and Mixamo files are never archived (licence; weights are identified by SHA-256 in environment/models.csv). _path_migration_backup holds pre-migration copies with this machine's absolute paths (see each folder's path_migration.json).

comparable: junction / stop reads (gesture accuracy) with coverage
not_comparable: round trip and watchdog figures (watchdog rule changed, AUDIT.md section 9 item 17)

task2_original_reported.source: AUDIT.md section 2 (the original's session folders are on Anisha's machine; figures transcribed from AUDIT.md, not recomputed)
task2_original_reported.junctions_at_first_ask: 14/14 (AUDIT.md section 2: all at the first ask; asks per junction not in its per-run table)
task2_original_reported.time_excl_stale_stops_note: 54.7 - 1.35 from the section 2 means (AUDIT.md section 13); per run not available
task2_original_reported.round_trip_ms: mean 0.78 (Unity-measured, old definition); max not in AUDIT.md
